title: DRA entry confirmation by final-day Binance USD-M BTC open interest
thesis: An otherwise valid positive-momentum DRA entry may transfer better when the final Binance BTCUSDT perpetual contract open interest is non-decreasing versus the prior calendar day, because the rally is less consistent with position-closing-only participation.
mechanism: At each complete UTC-day DRA signal, compare the checksum-bound Binance USD-M BTCUSDT sum_open_interest value at 23:55 with the prior calendar day's 23:55 value. Admit the unchanged next-H1-open parent entry when open interest is non-decreasing and veto it when open interest strictly contracts. A missing endpoint passes the parent through unchanged and is counted as unavailable.
economic_rationale: The filter is valuable only if it raises equal-capital fee- and slippage-adjusted total and realized PnL while preserving or improving drawdown, holding age, terminal inventory, and annual breadth; merely reducing participation or terminal losing inventory cannot pass.
